resources.string: Stop your phone addiction. And stayput.
Your essentials are here. The scroll can wait.
This app can wait.\nYour essential apps are still available.
Your default phone, messages and keyboard are always included.

Stayput detects the package name of the app you open during a focus session and shows a full-screen block if it is not in your allowed apps. It does not read screen text, record actions, or send data anywhere. It does nothing outside a session. Enable only if you agree to this app-blocking use.
